measures.name: FiltersAppliedRefs
measures.expression:
VAR __ParentAreas =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[Company Name] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Service'[Company Name] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Service'[Company Name], ASC
        ),
        "AreaParentName_display", 'Dim Service'[Company Name]
    )
VAR __ParentAreasCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Service'[Company Name] ),
        COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[Company Name] ) ),
        0
    )
VAR __MoreParentAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentAreasCount > 10,
        " and " & ( __ParentAreasCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
VAR __Services =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Name] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Name] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Name], ASC
        ),
        "TeamName_display", 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Name]
    )
VAR __ServicesCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Name] ),
        COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Name] ) ),
        0
    )
VAR __MoreServices =
    IF ( __ServicesCount > 10, " and " & ( __ServicesCount - 10 ) & " more", "" )
VAR _FC_ParentAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentAreasCount > 0,
        "| Company: " & CONCATENATEX ( __ParentAreas, [AreaParentName_display], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
VAR _FC_MoreParentAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentAreasCount > 5,
        " and " & ( __ParentAreasCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
VAR _FC_Services =
    IF (
        __ServicesCount > 0,
        "| Teams chosen: " & CONCATENATEX ( __Services, [TeamName_display], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
VAR _FC_MoreServices =
    IF ( __ServicesCount > 5, " and " & ( __ServicesCount - 10 ) & " more", "" )
VAR __ParentRegion =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[Region Name] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Service'[Region Name] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Service'[Region Name], ASC
        ),
        "AreaParentRegionName_display", 'Dim Service'[Region Name]
    )
VAR __ParentRegionCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Service'[Region Name] ),
        COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[Region Name] ) ),
        0
    )
VAR _FC_ParentRegion =
    IF (
        __ParentRegionCount > 0,
        "| Region: "
            & CONCATENATEX ( __ParentRegion, [AreaParentRegionName_display], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
VAR _FC_MoreParentRegionAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentRegionCount > 5,
        " and " & ( __ParentRegionCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
VAR __ParentDistrict =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[District Name] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Service'[District Name] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Service'[District Name], ASC
        ),
        "AreaParentDistrictName_display", 'Dim Service'[District Name]
    )
VAR __ParentDistrictCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Service'[District Name] ),
        COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[District Name] ) ),
        0
    )
VAR _FC_ParentDistrict =
    IF (
        __ParentDistrictCount > 0,
        "| District: "
            & CONCATENATEX ( __ParentDistrict, [AreaParentDistrictName_display], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
VAR _FC_MoreParentDistrictAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentDistrictCount > 5,
        " and " & ( __ParentDistrictCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
VAR __ParentServiceType =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[Service Type Name] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Service'[Service Type Name] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Service'[Service Type Name], ASC
        ),
        "AreaParentServiceTypeName_display", 'Dim Service'[Service Type Name]
    )
VAR __ParentServiceTypeCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Service'[Service Type Name] ),
        COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( 'Dim Service'[Service Type Name] ) ),
        0
    )
VAR _FC_ParentServiceType =
    IF (
        __ParentServiceTypeCount > 0,
        "| Service Type: "
            & CONCATENATEX ( __ParentServiceType, [AreaParentServiceTypeName_display], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
VAR _FC_MoreParentServiceTypeAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentServiceTypeCount > 5,
        " and " & ( __ParentServiceTypeCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
VAR __ParentTeamFunction =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Function] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Function] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Function], ASC
        ),
        "AreaParentTeamFunction_display", 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Function]
    )
VAR __ParentTeamFunctionCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Function] ),
        COUNTROWS (
            VALUES ( 'Dim Tangata Whaiora Team'[Tangata Whaiora Team Function] )
        ),
        0
    )
VAR _FC_ParentTeamFunction =
    IF (
        __ParentTeamFunctionCount > 0,
        "| Team Function: "
            & CONCATENATEX ( __ParentTeamFunction, [AreaParentTeamFunction_display], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
VAR _FC_MoreParentTeamFunctionAreas =
    IF (
        __ParentTeamFunctionCount > 5,
        " and " & ( __ParentTeamFunctionCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
VAR __FinancialYears =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        TOPN (
            10,
            FILTER (
                VALUES ( 'Dim Date'[Financial Year Desc] ),
                NOT ( ISBLANK ( 'Dim Date'[Financial Year Desc] ) )
            ),
            'Dim Date'[Financial Year Desc], ASC
        ),
        "FinancialYearNum", 'Dim Date'[Financial Year Desc]
    )
VAR __FYearCount =
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( 'Dim Date'[Financial Year Desc] ),
        COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( 'Dim Date'[Financial Year Desc] ) ),
        0
    )
VAR __MoreFinYears =
    IF (
        __FYearCount > 10,
        " and " & ( __FYearCount - 10 ) & " more",
        ""
    )
    VAR ___FinYearDisplay =
    IF (
        __FYearCount > 0,
        "| Financial Year/s: " & CONCATENATEX ( __FinancialYears, [FinancialYearNum], ", " ),
        BLANK ()
    )
RETURN
     " -- Summary of filters applied to page: " & " " & _FC_ParentAreas & _FC_MoreParentAreas & " " & _FC_ParentRegion & _FC_MoreParentRegionAreas
        & UNICHAR ( 10 )
        & UNICHAR ( 13 ) & " " 
        &___FinYearDisplay & " "        
        
        & _FC_ParentDistrict & _FC_MoreParentDistrictAreas & " " & _FC_ParentServiceType & _FC_MoreParentServiceTypeAreas & _FC_ParentTeamFunction & _FC_MoreParentTeamFunctionAreas & _FC_Services & _FC_MoreServices

VAR FYStartMonth = 7
VAR ThisFYStart =
    DATE(YEAR(TODAY()) - IF(MONTH(TODAY()) < FYStartMonth, 1, 0), FYStartMonth, 1)
VAR StartDate = EDATE(ThisFYStart, -24)
VAR EndDate = EDATE(ThisFYStart, -13) + DAY(ThisFYStart) - 1
RETURN
IF(
    SELECTEDVALUE('Dim Date'[Calendar Date]) >= StartDate &&
    SELECTEDVALUE('Dim Date'[Calendar Date]) <= EndDate,
    1,
    0
)
